body:
Think of Labradorite like your fairy godmother, here to sprinkle your life with pixie dust. With the mystical energy of Labradorite, sparks of neon will illuminate the path to your destiny. Labradorite is a stone of magic and curiosity. Its base color is dark gray, but when it catches the light, flashes of iridescent color appear. Legend says that some of the Northern Lights of the Aurora Borealis are held within Labradorite, giving it the colorful flash known as labradorescence. It is a tantalizing stone that takes you on a journey of color, bringing to light the unknown of a situation. It is a symbolic reminder to look deeper and from many angles, instead of taking things at face value. There’s often more than meets the eye!

Wearing or holding Labradorite helps you tap into a higher state of consciousness. It’s a protective stone as well, so it will keep your energy body grounded, while allowing you to explore the expanded states of the universe. By connecting to and healing all chakras, it boosts mental and spiritual power. Labradorite crystal properties are especially linked with the third eye chakra, the center of intuition. The Labradorite meaning opens you up, forcing you to become self-aware enough to see what your true intentions are. Only then can it help you to magnify your resolutions with your full power.

And speaking of full power, the influence of labradorite energy on the spirit will be a lightning bolt of inspiration. Just as light catches sparks of neon within the labradorite stone, the spiritual illumination that you find when connected to labradorite will send sparks of passion through you. Let labradorite entice your curiosity and compel you toward a journey of self-discovery. The adventure may lead you to somewhere as beautiful as it is unexpected.
